parsed.notes:
Dein Profil sets required defaults; no optional section heading occurs.
Idealerweise makes the managed-Kubernetes examples and PostgreSQL/MongoDB optional; Kubernetes itself is separately required.
Argo CD and Kustomize are required examples in the unmarked qualifications bullet.
Logging, alerting and automated deployments are retained as unmapped practices rather than silently equated with broader taxonomy entries.
Kubernetes-/Cloud-Security is provisionally mapped to cybersecurity; review the breadth of that mapping.
AKS, EKS and GKE do not imply separate Azure, AWS or GCP requirements.
The degree is required with an accepted vocational-qualification alternative; unspecified completed university studies map to bachelor.
Fundierte Erfahrung and umfangreiche Kenntnisse are not explicit proven-experience or years-based seniority signals.
Technologies and practices appearing only under Deine Aufgaben are excluded.
